sourceText:
Morgan Ellis — Senior Backend Engineer
EXPERIENCE
Northwind Data, Senior Backend Engineer, 2019–2024. Cut API p95 latency by 40% between 2019 and 2024 while serving 2M requests/day across 3 regions. Led migration of 40+ services to Kubernetes with zero downtime. Introduced Kafka event pipelines processing 15M messages/day.
Bright Labs, Backend Engineer, 2016–2019. Built billing services in Go handling $12M annual volume between 2016 and 2019. Shipped a PostgreSQL schema-automation tool adopted by 5 teams.
EDUCATION
B.Sc. Computer Science, University of Toronto, 2012–2016
SKILLS
Go, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Terraform, Redis
LANGUAGES
English (native), French (B2)
PROJECT
Service-mesh toolkit: open-source CLI for traffic shaping.
CERTIFICATION
CKA — Certified Kubernetes Administrator, 2022
